theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), X.support ⊆ closedBall 0 R → ∃ C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → C ω = X ψ)
